SELECT cand_election_yr, count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'H' AND try_cast(cand_election_yr AS integer) IN (2000, 2024) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which agencies have posted the most grant opportunities on Grants.gov?
SELECT agencyname, count(DISTINCT opportunityid) AS opportunities FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What fixed rate did I bonds issued in November 2023 carry?
SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(fixed_rate AS double) AS fixed_rate FROM govblock_treasury.i_bonds_interest_rates WHERE issue_year_month = '2023-11'
Which federal courts have heard the most patent cases?
SELECT court_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many jobs were located in Manhattan in 2015?
SELECT sum(c000) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2015 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '36061'
Which balancing authorities oversee the most power plants?
SELECT balancing_authority_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE balancing_authority_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which occupations employ the most people in California?

SELECT occ_title, try_cast(tot_emp AS double) AS employed FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'California' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' AND occ_code <> '00-0000' AND occ_code NOT LIKE '%0000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds found in patents weigh more than 1,500 daltons?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_compounds WHERE mol_weight > 1500
Which states have had the most water discharge permit inspections?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many kindergarteners attended New York public schools in 2024-25?

SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS kindergarteners FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' AND st = 'NY' AND grade = 'Kindergarten'
Where in New York state, city by city, did deadly crashes happen most often in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'New York' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many brand names does ChEBI record?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'BRAND NAME'
Which exclusion programs account for the most debarred entities?
SELECT exclusion_program, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospice cost reports were filed for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_hospc14_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
How many jobs in accommodation and food service were located in Clark County, Nevada in 2019?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cns18 AS double)) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'nv' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '32003'
How many approved drugs in ChEMBL are natural products?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND natural_product = 1
What was the personal saving rate for 2020 as a whole?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataa WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020'
Which cities in Texas have the most companies registered to do business with the federal government?
SELECT physical_address_city, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many veterans live in Ohio?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US39' AND variable = 'B21001_E002'
Which U.S. patents have been cited most often by later patents?

SELECT p.patent_title, c.citation_patent_id, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation c JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p ON p.patent_id = c.citation_patent_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many hours of 2023 did the real-time price in western New York fall below zero?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name = 'WEST' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double) < 0
Which states deposited the most into the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2019?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS deposited FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '11-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2019' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average dipole moment of a QM9 molecule?
SELECT avg(mu) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_qm9
How many molecules in ChEMBL are in phase 3 clinical trials?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 3
Which states had the most fatal crashes in work zones in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(wrk_zone AS integer) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many physics theses are recorded in INSPIRE?
SELECT count(*) AS theses FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE document_type LIKE '%thesis%'
What are the largest grant opportunities by estimated total funding?

SELECT opportunitytitle, agencyname, max(try_cast(estimatedtotalprogramfunding AS double)) AS total_funding FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which sections of California law were amended most recently?
SELECT citation, try_cast(last_amended_year AS integer) AS last_amended FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ca' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which ZIP codes in New York City complain to the FCC the most?
SELECT zip, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'NY' AND city = 'New York' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity did the United States generate in 2024, in thousand megawatt-hours?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.ALL-US-99.A' AND period = '2024'
Does NSF make more standard grants or continuing grants?
SELECT value, count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the largest total personal income in 2024?

SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS income_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geofips LIKE '%000' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest hourly real-time power price in New York City in 2022?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT max(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which states are home to the most registered section 527 political organizations?
SELECT column11 AS state, count(*) AS organizations FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8871 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did regulation service cost on average in western New York's real-time market in 2019?
Nyiso As Prices Real Time 5 Min Rtasp
SELECT avg(try_cast(west_regulation_mwhr AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_as_prices_real_time_5_min_rtasp WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2019'
Which states had the most candidates for the U.S. House in 2022?
SELECT cand_office_st, count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'H' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
